malware.name: Exmatter
malware.description: A custom exfiltration tool used by ransomware operators to steal user files, databases, and compressed files. It uploads data to a preconfigured server via SFTP.  It also has anti-forensic capabilities and can use a WebDav client as a secondary exfiltration method.

tools.name: Exmatter
tools.description: Custom exfiltration tool that iterates through folders, prioritizes recently modified files, and excludes directories within 'C:\ProgramData\'. It uses SFTP to exfiltrate data, with options for WebDav failover and a SOCKS5 proxy.
